newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian bank robbers get held up themselves.
newsitem.headline: Colombian bank robbers get held up themselves.

text.p: A pair of Colombian thieves got a taste of their own medicine when they were held up outside a bank they had just robbed in the northwestern city of Medellin, local news reports said on Monday.

The Cripton television news programme said Heyne Zapata, 21, and Carlos Andres Bedoya, 19, stole about $1,600 from a bank in the upscale Poblado district and were fleeing on foot when they were stopped by muggers a block away from the scene of their crime.

Zapata and Bedoya wound up under arrest for the bank job and the muggers made off with the loot, Cripton said. It quoted Ernesto Salgado Mendez, a local police officer in charge of the case, as saying Zapata and Bedoya had been set up by fellow gang members.
